full_judgment: 3. It is stated in the application that upon receiving summons defendant No. 7, being opposite party No. 7 herein entered appearance and prayed for time for filing written statement. Defendant No. 7 is a practicing lawyer under Pirojpur District Bar Association while the president of the District Bar Association, who is also public prosecutor, threatened the plaintiff on behalf of defendant No. 7 in Presence of some witnesses for withdrawing the suit from the Court. Defendant No. 7 also filed MP Case No. 37 of 2017 on 27-4-2017 against the petitioners under section 143/385/386/506/38 of the Penal Code before the Senior Judicial Magistrate which was sent to Officer-in-Charge of the Police Station to start a regular case giving rise to Nazipur Police Station Case No. 11 dated 28-4-2017 but the investigation Officer after Investigation submitted final report with a prayer for permission to file proceeding under section 211 of the Bangladesh Penal Code against the complainant. It is stated that the petitioners voluntarily surrendered with a prayer for bail on 7-6-2017 to Senior Judicial Magistrate who rejected the bail and sent them to custody. After submission of final report on 2-8-2017 the prayer for the petitioners for bail was considered but the informant filed an application for staying the order on the ground of filing revision to the higher Court and date was fixed on 7-8-2017. The bail bond submitted by the petitioners were kept with the record and on 5-11-2017 on the basis of compromise final report was accepted and prayer for prosecution under section 211 of the Bangladesh Penal Code was rejected. It is further stated that opposite party No. 7 filed CR case No. 105 of 2017 on 19-11-2017 against the petitioners before the Senior Judicial Magistrate, Pirojpur under sections 143/147/148/447/448/379/380/114/506(1) of the Penal Code which was also sent to the Officer-in Charge Nazirpur police station to start GR case wherein the president of the Pirpojpur Bar Association Mr. Khan Md Alauddin and 3 others lawyers were cited as witnesses of the case. On receiving the complaint, the Officer-in-Charge started Nazirpur Police Station Case No. 8 dated 24-11-2017. It is stated that due to opposite party No. 7 being a practicing lawyer of Pirojpur Bar Association and president of the Bar being cited as witness, the petitioners are in difficult position to get any reliable lawyer to conduct their case to the Court. It is further stated that the accused persons enlarged on anticipatory bail from the High Court Division for 8 weeks in the said criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 56769 of 2017 and after expiry of 8 weeks they voluntarily surrendered with the prayer for bail on 7-2-2018 but bail prayer for accused Md Afzal Sheikh and Md Maksed Sheikh being petitioner Nos. 1 and 2 of the miscellaneous case were rejected. Subsequently, Makshed Sheik was enlarged on bail from the Court of District and Sessions Judge, Pirojpur and the accused Afzal Sheikh was enlarged on bail from the High Court Division on 9-4-2018 in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 17691 of 2018. It is further stated that informant Advocate Mr. Taposh Kumar Vokto in collusion with the president of District Bar Association also exposed that none of the advocates of the said Bar would conduct the civil suit filed by the plaintiffs. It is further stated after filing final report and permission to file prosecution under section 211 of the Bangladesh Penal Code, the informant opposite party No. 7 came more arrogant and threatened the plaintiff petitioners to give a good lesson and he is taking all out preparation to kill the plaintiff petitioners if they goes to Pirojpur in connection with the suit and, as such, the petitioners became afraid to lodge any GD entry to the police station.
